crossRefs.note: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.
Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less…
who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might…
But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother…
Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.
Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast…

people.name: Magadan
people.line: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene

people.name: Mary_Magdalene
people.line: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

translations.web: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
translations.bsb: as well as some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
translations.kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
